question: How does a workflow script narrow a child's tools and clamp its shell commands?
answer: The spawn validates arrays of unpadded tool names and Bash(...) rules, merges the deny list into the child pool, adds an implicit mcp__* deny for a clamp, refuses a schema spawn whose StructuredOutput is denied or a clamp with no shell tool, and at execution admits a shell command only when every reading matches a rule in every clamp group; an incomplete reading set is refused.

disallowedTools.entryGrammar: Tool or Tool(content); first/last unescaped parens
disallowedTools.mcp: mcp__<server>, mcp__<server>__<tool>, mcp__*; empty/wildcard segments refused
disallowedTools.case: case mismatch against the pool is refused
disallowedTools.noOp: an entry naming no pool tool has no effect

bashCommandClamp.shape: array of Bash(<command or prefix>) rules
bashCommandClamp.prefix: content ending :* matches the prefix, its space suffix and xargs forms
bashCommandClamp.groups: every inherited clamp group must admit every reading

spawnRefusals: clamp with no shell tool in the resolved pool
